dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate concave curvature on the trailing edge with a distinct posterior notch at the basal junction.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a medium pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear incline approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small white circular depigmented lesions on the lateral flank; a deep horizontal notch at the posterior base of the dorsal fin; irregular, rough skin texture on the fin surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly mottled and non-uniform skin pigmentation pattern across the visible dorsal surface.
